people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

translations.web: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer.
translations.bsb: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a meadow. But Ephraim will bring out his children for slaughter.
translations.kjv: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
translations.asv: Ephraim, like as I have seen Tyre, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring out his children to the slayer.
